name: Lord Of Confusion + Hazing Lungs
description: For something heavier, catch this double bill at one of Porto's most legendary alternative venues on the top floor of a car park.
longDescription:
Maus Hábitos hosts a double bill of heavier music on June 25, 2026, featuring Lord Of Confusion and Hazing Lungs. Lord Of Confusion is a Porto-based band known for their psychedelic doom metal sound, blending heavy riffs with atmospheric elements. Hazing Lungs, also from Porto, delivers a raw and intense brand of hardcore punk, characterized by aggressive vocals and fast-paced instrumentation. This event brings together two local acts representing distinct but complementary heavy genres.

Attendees can expect an evening of high-energy performances in the distinctive setting of Maus Hábitos. Located on the top floor of a multi-storey car park, the venue offers an alternative and industrial atmosphere, known for its commitment to experimental and underground music. The audience typically comprises fans of metal, punk, and alternative music, creating an engaged and energetic environment for live shows. The performances will be primarily musical, with no specific language component.

Tickets for the event are priced variably. Maus Hábitos is situated near the city centre and is accessible via public transport. It is approximately a 10-minute walk from Bolhão metro station, which serves multiple lines. Due to its location within a car park building, specific accessibility details should be confirmed directly with the venue.
